# cidaas_security_settings (Resource)

Tenant-wide fraud-detection settings via `fraud-detection-srv/settings`. This resource exposes **`blocking_setting`**, **`repeated_login_blocking_mechanism`**, and **`rule_configuration.repeated_login_blocking_mechanism_enabled`** only; other fraud-detection API fields are not configurable here. Updates use HTTP PATCH (partial merge). Destroy only removes the resource from Terraform state; it does **not** reset settings in cidaas.

State only stores attributes you set in Terraform. Remote values for omitted fields are not written to state (so apply matches partial configuration). After `terraform import`, the first refresh may load a full API snapshot into state until your `.tf` matches or you use `ignore_changes`.

Required OAuth scopes on the Terraform client: `cidaas:fds_settings_read`, `cidaas:fds_settings_write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires OAuth scopes: cidaas:fds_settings_read, cidaas:fds_settings_write

resource "cidaas_security_settings" "example" {
  blocking_setting = {
    enabled = true
  }

  repeated_login_blocking_mechanism = {
    blocking_duration_in_min     = 10
    blocked_count                = 4
    blocked_count_unknown_device = 2
  }

  rule_configuration = {
    repeated_login_blocking_mechanism_enabled = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `blocking_setting` (Attributes) Blocking / allowlist configuration (`blockingSetting` in the API). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blocking_setting))
- `repeated_login_blocking_mechanism` (Attributes) Brute-force / repeated-login thresholds (`repeatedLoginBlockingMechanism`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repeated_login_blocking_mechanism))
- `rule_configuration` (Attributes) Subset of `ruleConfiguration` supported by this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_configuration))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable id for this singleton resource. After the first apply, import with `terraform import cidaas_security_settings.<name> security_settings`.

<a id="nestedatt--blocking_setting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `blocking_setting`

Optional:

- `black_listed_email_domains` (Set of String) Email domains on the block list. Set to an empty set to send an empty list in PATCH (clear), if the API supports it.
- `black_listed_identifiers` (Set of String) Blocked identifiers (e.g. usernames or emails).
- `black_listed_ips` (Set of String) IPs or CIDRs on the block list.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether blocking is enabled.
- `excluded_emails_from_black_list` (Set of String) Emails excluded from domain blocking.
- `excluded_ips_from_black_list` (Set of String) IPs excluded from IP blocking.
- `subs` (Set of String) Subscription identifiers used by blocking rules.
- `white_listed_email_domains` (Set of String) Email domains on the allow list.
- `white_listed_ips` (Set of String) IPs on the allow list.


<a id="nestedatt--repeated_login_blocking_mechanism"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repeated_login_blocking_mechanism`

Optional:

- `blocked_count` (Number) Failed attempts before block (known device).
- `blocked_count_unknown_device` (Number) Failed attempts before block (unknown device).
- `blocking_duration_in_min` (Number) How long logins stay blocked, in minutes.


<a id="nestedatt--rule_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_configuration`

Optional:

- `repeated_login_blocking_mechanism_enabled` (Boolean) `repeatedLoginBlockingMechanismEnabled`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cidaas_security_settings.example security_settings
```
